title: hieracium pseudalpinum subsp. cochlearioides
intro: Hieracium pseudalpinum subsp. cochlearioides, commonly known as hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. The health benefits of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pseudalpinum subsp. cochlearioides include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation and its potential as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
